name: How can I make my small laundry room feel brighter with lighting?

mainEntity.name: How can I make my small laundry room feel brighter with lighting?

acceptedAnswer.text: To make a small laundry room feel brighter, focus on maximizing ambient and task lighting. Use recessed lights or slim flush-mount fixtures to avoid clutter. Installing a light fixture with a higher lumen output (brightness) and a cool white color temperature (4000K-5000K) can significantly improve the perception of space. Incorporate under-cabinet strip lighting if you have shelving or a folding counter. Additionally, pairing good lighting with light-colored paint and reflective surfaces can amplify the brightness.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maximize ambient light with recessed or slim flush-mount fixtures. Use high lumen, cool white bulbs. Add under-cabinet task lighting and light-colored surfaces.
